扳机瞄准和开火，左摇杆移动，配好常用动作后连续填键。: Triggers aim and fire, left stick moves. Fill in the game bindings for a ready-made layout.
右摇杆控制视角，预设攻击、闪避和交互，创建后可以连续填键。: Use the right stick for the camera. Fill in bindings for attacks, dodges and interactions after creating the profile.
还没有动作，先录下第一个游戏键位。: Record the first game binding to add an action.
已录下游戏键位，可以填写动作名称。: The game binding is recorded. You can name the action now.
点「新增动作」录下游戏键位，手柄输入可以稍后设置。: Click New action to record the game binding. Assign the controller input later.
请先给待绑定的动作设置手柄输入。: Assign controller inputs to the pending actions first.
已写入草稿，绑定手柄输入后可应用。: Added to the draft. Assign controller inputs before applying.
配置或动作已改变，请重新打开批量填键。: The profile or its actions changed. Reopen Fill game bindings.
已写入配置草稿，核对后可应用修改。: Bindings added to the profile draft. Review them and apply your changes when ready.
按游戏里的键位依次填写。跳过的项目保留当前输出，录入结果先留在这张表。: Enter your game bindings in order. Skipped actions keep their current output. Review the captured bindings here.
松开手柄按键并让摇杆回中后可以继续。: Release the controller buttons and center the sticks to continue.
请先结束当前录入、校准或输出准备。: Finish the current recording, calibration, or output setup first.
小窗已置顶。切到游戏键位页，在小窗里点「新增动作」开始录键。: The editor stays on top. Open the game's controls page and click New action in the floating window.
按下并松开游戏键位: Press and release the game binding
在这一区域点击鼠标按钮或滚动滚轮。: Click a mouse button or scroll the wheel in this area.
点动作旁的「录入」，或从选中的动作开始连续填写。: Click Record beside an action or start recording in order from the selected row.
点击动作所在行修改游戏键位。: Click an action row to change its game binding.
批量填键数据无效，请重新打开动作列表。: The binding list data is invalid. Reopen the action list.
请在 Studio 打开录入悬浮窗。: Open the floating binding editor from Studio.
录入悬浮窗已打开。: The floating binding editor is already open.
录入悬浮窗已关闭。: The floating binding editor is closed.
请在录入悬浮窗中操作。: Use the floating binding editor to do this.
录入已结束，请重新点击录入。: Recording ended. Click Record again to continue.
